published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Night Elf, with the Night Elf rotation (Elune's Light held for the trinket, elune=1; it was the race override); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 841.5 as Tauren on the same sim)

summary: Moonkin that keeps Insect Swarm and Moonfire up. It weaves Wrath and Starfire to spend every Eclipse charge.
rotation: Pre-pull: Starfire rank 6 at -3s, so it lands at the pull
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown. Innervate has its own condition.
Elune's Light (Night Elf) with the spell power trinket, and at -0.1s with it and the potion
Insect Swarm when it is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when its DoT is down, with more than 8s left
Starfire when Clearcasting is up. Wrath doesn't use it up.
Moonfire when a Starfire would not land before the end
Wrath when Eclipse is at 2 charges or fewer and no Wrath is in flight
caveats: No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks. Starfire rank 6 costs 13.3 DPS at 180s.
The Grovekeeper 5-piece Eclipse bonus would add 12.6 DPS over the 2-piece. Swarming Idol is worth 3.3. Both were measured on older gear.
Mana runs out in 300s fights, where a plain weave is 2 DPS ahead.
Wrath VIII's base damage is ×1.085 the client's value.
Unverified: Omen of Clarity's proc chance on spells, and that Eclipse charges come when Wrath lands.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second one (Owl) would add 15.1 DPS.
Subtlety 3 (Restoration) is taken for threat. It costs 6.1 / 6.1 / 6.2 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec balance (caster group: Mana Spring, Kings + Wisdom, no Might, own Moonkin Form crit; 30 yd range; Innervate on self). Duration set to 180s, durationVariation 20 as in EncounterLevel60. No edits needed. Night Elf since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick, with the level60 rotation regenerated with elune=1 (tools/rotopt/druid_presets.sh), which was req/races/druid__balance.NightElf.json; the same rotation is 0.0 for a Tauren (Elune's Light is the Night Elf's).
